author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
After a week of testing, we review the long-awaited Xreal Aura mixed reality glasses. Developed with Google and running Android XR, these lightweight spatial computing glasses combines the best display glasses hardware with a dedicated compute puck and wide Android app support. Here's how they work and our take on the design and engineering choices that get it to this formfactor.

XREAL Aura: https://www.xreal.com/us/aura
Disclosure: This product was sent to us by the manufacturer for purposes of review and is not sponsored. 

Shot by Josh Self and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
